info.amfiName: Aditya Birla Sun Life US Treasury 1-3 Year Bond ETFs Passive FOF
info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Other Scheme - FoF Overseas)
info.objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate returns that are in line with the performance of units of ETFs focused on US Treasury Bonds having maturity between 1-3 Years. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.

info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Other Scheme - FoF Overseas)

The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.

info.amfiName: Bandhan US Treasury Bond 0-1 year specific Debt Passive FOF
info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Other Scheme - FoF Overseas)
info.objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to provide long-term capital appreciation by passively investing in units / shares of overseas Index Funds and / or ETFs which track an index with US treasury securities in the 0-1 year maturity range as its constituents, subject to tracking error. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized.

info.amfiName: DSP US Specific Debt Passive FoF
info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Other Scheme - FoF Overseas)
info.objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate income & long term capital appreciation by investing in units of ETFs and/or Funds focused on US Treasury Bonds There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.

info.amfiName: Axis US Specific Treasury Dynamic Debt Passive FOF
info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Overseas Fund of Funds - Fund of Funds investing overseas)
info.objective: The primary investment objective of the Scheme is to provide regular income by investing in units of overseas ETFs where the investment mandate is to invest in US treasury securities across duration. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
